notes.title: September major update
notes.notes:
We published Survival Driver now big updates. Here is list of all updates that has published:

- Some road textures changed
- sportbike, crossbike and sportcar handling changed
- game optimited. Project is now smaller
- added 4 new track
- crossbike level 6 track replaced new track

Totally Survival Driver has now 20 tracks

notes.title: Project size optimization
notes.notes:
Project size has now little bit optimized and it is now smaller. Current project size is approximately 10.3GB, last version was almost 12GB. Our team will hole time now working that can reduce project size between 9-10GB in next updates.

Also some new features is now under consideration

notes.title: Survival Driver published
notes.notes:
Me and my friend minor indie bike game Survival Driver version 1.0 has now published. First version contains 2 bikes, 10 tracks and basic settings menu. 

First version contains also immediately steam trading cards, background, emoticons and badges

Bug fixes and other fixes coming when community reports them. 

Bigger updates/batches coming in every month, like more vehicles, tracks etc
